headline: Find experts your friends actually know.
subtitle: No more scouring communities or asking everyone you know. One search in Naura instantly shows which of your contacts can reach the person you need.

contactGraph.title: Organization
contactGraph.description: Everything sorted into groups and tags. No heavy CRM required — you build your own interaction chains for client work, networking, or just keeping in touch.

handshake.title: Handshake search
handshake.description: "I need a B2B digital marketer in Dubai." Naura searches your network up to 7 handshakes and shows who can introduce you.

telegramBot.title: Telegram bot
telegramBot.description: Forward the bot a message from the person you want to save, and they're added to your contacts automatically. And you can record a meeting note as a voice message.

mcpAgents.title: MCP for AI agents
mcpAgents.tagline: "Naura, who do I know in Berlin?"
mcpAgents.description: Plug Naura into Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-capable agent. Your graph becomes an API the agent can reason over.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Private member directories, events, base of knowledge. Naura handles the infrastructure so organizers don't have to.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Set your own reminders about interactions and never miss a birthday. Naura nudges you when it's time to reach out.
